entities.name: José Mário Angonese
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Mário Scalon Angonese is a Brazilian prelate of the Catholic Church. He is the fifth Metropolitan Archbishop of the Roman Catholic Metropolitan Archdiocese of Cascavel, appointed by Pope Francis on 2 May 2024 to replace Dom. Adelar Baruffi. He served as Bishop of Uruguaiana from 2017 to 2024.
